body:
Approved spec: .adlc/specs/SC-001-product-vision.md. Do not edit that file or specs/001-product-vision/spec.md. Prices below are fictional and labeled source fictional. Do not call a live retailer, bank, or Gemini API in tests. Do not commit secrets. Rails stay empty; P3 freezes them later. Money is integer LKR. A percent discount is (amount * rate_bps) // 10000.

Rewrite README.md as the judge script for the guest UI. No login. Include every required string exactly:
- Use sample receipt
- Sample catalog — not live shelf prices.
- Why isn’t rice discounted?
- Show a basket this offer refuses
- No order is sent.
- Cloud Run
- Secret Manager
- a heading line that is exactly: ## Cannot do

The Cannot do section must say the app does not provide live prices, live stock, real orders, card numbers, or bank affiliation. Persona shown: Karuppan, Saturday, Commercial Bank credit, budget about LKR 12,000. Tell the judge the first load can take tens of seconds. Do not paste keys or project ids.

Acceptance criteria:
1. README.md contains each required string and the Cannot do heading. Verify: python scripts/check_judge_readme.py
2. The secret scan exits 0. Verify: gitleaks detect --source . --redact
If gitleaks is missing, install the official release binary, run that command, and do not commit the binary or any secret it prints.
title: Document the judge path and secret scan
